description: Use this when a visitor asks about operating hours for one supported park within the next 60 park-local days. Schedule windows have guest-facing categories and labels; Early Entry is an eligibility-based window, not a separate ticketed event. These are reported schedules, which the operator may change.

date.description: First park-local date, YYYY-MM-DD, from today through 59 days ahead. Defaults to today.

days.description: Number of consecutive days, 1 to 60. Defaults to 1.

park_id.description: Park key (magic-kingdom), canonical park ID, park name, or shorthand such as mk, epcot, hs, ak, dl, dca, usf, ioa, epic or ush. A park name works directly, with no lookup first.

name: parky_get_hours
title: Get Parky park operating hours
